abilities._comment: When this attacks a hero, look at the top card of their deck. If it's red, you may destroy it. If you do, this gets +4{p}. Composed from generic primitives — LOOK_AT stores the card as 'seen', the MAY block is gated on it being red (pitch 1), and the +4 lives inside the block so declining gives no bonus.

effects.prompt: Destroy the revealed red card for +4{p}?
